author.description: The user who created the case update, mapped to current_user->id in PHP

text.description: The update content; legacy stores truncated slug in name (50 chars) and full HTML in description

timestamp.description: Auto-set by SugarBean save; in CaseFlow this is the datetime field on CaseUpdate

internal.description: Boolean flag controlling email notification suppression; internal=true skips contact email

legacyDefect.description: 35 legacy cases have Closed_* status but state=Open in the SuiteCRM database
legacyDefect.correction: CaseFlow derives state from status on import and every write path, making this defect impossible
